name: FreightInvoiceAuditConsole
tagline: Pay carriers what the contract says – every freight invoice audited line by line, with approve, short-pay and dispute in Power Apps.
description: A complete freight audit and payment app for shippers, 3PLs and AP teams: audits every carrier invoice against the contracted linehaul, the fuel surcharge table and accessorial rules (detention with POD wait times, liftgate authorisation, lumper receipt and cap, unapproved accessorials), runs math and duplicate checks, checks BOL / POD evidence and a variance tolerance, then guides the approve / short-pay / dispute / reject / pay workflow with approval limits and shows the money found and recovered per check and carrier. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Line-by-line charge audit: linehaul vs contract, fuel vs table, detention vs POD hours, liftgate, lumper, other accessorials
Math check and duplicate invoice / shipment detection
Variance tolerance (amount or %) with suggested payment
Approve, short-pay with reason codes, dispute with a live notice preview, reject, reopen, mark paid
Approval limit for auditors and manager override with reason
Evidence checklist: BOL, POD, detention times, liftgate on BOL, lumper receipt, contract rate
Audit queue with My queue, exceptions, grouping and bulk approve-clean / assign / mark paid
Status board with drag and drop validated by the workflow rules
Carrier billing-accuracy scorecard: overbilled, recovered, exception rate, top issue
Recovery KPIs, ageing and audit SLA, AuditCsv and SummaryJson outputs
Roles: freight auditor, audit manager, AP clerk; history and undo
Power Fx outputs and events (NewRecordJson for every decision)
controlType: standard (two controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
